dimensions.name: CLI surface and compatibility
dimensions.justification: Repeatable selectors preserve order and no-selector behavior remains reachable, but selected fields are accepted with formatted/JSON output instead of conflicting clearly.
evidence: product.diff: StringArray flags and ordered resolveSelectedFields loop
product.diff: exporter.Write remains reachable after field resolution without a selector/exporter conflict

dimensions.name: Resolution and diagnostics
dimensions.justification: Case-insensitive resolution, canonical headers, and actionable unknown-field errors are present. Ambiguous-ID candidates are collected in input/API order without sorting, so deterministic ordering is not established.
evidence: baseline/pkg/cmd/project/shared/queries/resolve_fields.go: unknown-name and unknown-ID candidates are sorted
baseline/pkg/cmd/project/shared/queries/resolve_fields.go: ambiguous IDs are appended without sort

dimensions.name: Query path and pagination
dimensions.justification: The normal path reuses definitions returned with items and safely returns errors before rendering, but it never paginates project fields when the initial field connection has another page.

dimensions.name: Field-value rendering
dimensions.justification: All listed scalar, structured, and multi-value types have human-readable rendering, and missing/unknown values become empty. Raw text is returned without removing carriage returns or replacing newlines, so multiline cells can corrupt rows.
evidence: product.diff: FieldValueNodes.DisplayValue covers date, number, select, text, iteration, milestone, repository, labels, pull requests, users, and reviewers
product.diff: DisplayValue returns raw text/date/title values with no CR/LF normalization

dimensions.name: End-to-end table behavior
dimensions.justification: Selected canonical headers are appended in request order; each row maps field values by field node ID and emits one cell for every selected field, preserving alignment and empty missing cells.
evidence: product.diff: printResults builds headers from selected fields
product.diff: values[value.ID()] maps values by ID and the selected-field loop emits every cell

dimensions.name: Failure safety and maintainability
dimensions.justification: Mutual-exclusion and resolution failures return before rendering. The change uses existing query types and table/exporter paths and is focused on field selection and display.
evidence: product.diff: cmdutil.MutuallyExclusive is checked in RunE
product.diff: resolveSelectedFields errors return before exporter or printResults
tests.log: focused package test command exited 0

criticalGaps: Selected fields do not conflict with explicit formatted/JSON output.
Requested fields beyond the first returned field-definition page cannot be resolved.
Field values are not normalized to remove carriage returns and replace newlines.
